小鸭子

从前，有一只没有名字的小鸭子。

他独自生活在一座很远很远的山上，
那儿整天都刮着大风，天气冷得不得了。
page_text_en:
Act 2
The Little Duck

Once upon a time, there was a little duck with no name.

He lived all by himself on a mountain far, far away,
where the wind blew all day long and the weather was terribly cold.
summary_zh: 本页开启绘本的第二幕，介绍了一只没有名字的小鸭子，它独自生活在遥远寒冷的山上，为后续故事发展做铺垫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
没有人给他写信。
没有人打电话给他。
也没有人给他发过电子邮件。
他只能一个人看电影。
或者独自打乒乓球。
有时候，小鸭子也会跑到山顶上看日出。
他常常静静地待着，看着太阳慢慢地浮上天空，又慢慢地滑下山啦。
这样的生活真没意思。
page_text_en:
No one writes to him.
No one calls him.
No one sends him emails either.
He can only watch movies alone.
Or play ping-pong by himself.
Sometimes, the little duck will run to the top of the mountain to watch the sunrise.
He often sits quietly, watching the sun slowly rise into the sky, then slowly slide down the mountain.
This kind of life is really boring.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了一只孤独的小鸭子独自生活在山上，没有人与它联系，它只能独自看电影、打乒乓球或看日出，感到生活非常无聊。

Henry stopped suddenly.
The little duck slowly stood up, and a tear rolled down the corner of his eye.

"I'm really sorry. I... I'm not a dog."
He looked down. "I'm just a little duck."

"You see, I don't have soft ears, no wagging tail,
no soft, wet nose, and no long, drooling tongue," the little duck said sadly.

"Hmm..." Henry was deeply disappointed.

But after thinking for a moment, he picked up the little duck
and took him home.

小鸭子的特长
1. 可以漂在水面上，也可以潜到水中。可以用这呼吸。洗澡的时候很有趣，生活在水边，对搜寻水底的宝藏很有帮助。可以抓鱼，也可以帮我找回丢在游泳池里的东西。
2. 会飞：可以举办飞行表演来赚零花钱。擅长记住在树上的风筝、飞到别人家花园里的飞盘和其他东西回来。可以为他国并跟踪别人。
3. 这只与众不同的小鸭子还擅长取悦别人——非常聪明。
4. 简单的技术非常棒，会建城堡、巢穴和树屋等。
5. 现在可以做印度头巾，可以逗小娃娃玩耍。
6. 这只鸭子还会讲话——说很稀奇，不过倒也不是完全没有。
另外
也不会掉毛，不会乱叫，不需要散步和专业培训，不会撕咬家具、鞋子或衣服，也不会在地毯上撒尿。
……递给小鸭子。
“虽然你不是一条小狗，
可是，你也不是一只简简单单的鸭子哦。
实际上，你是我遇上的最完美的宠物啦！
“让我想想，你就叫斯巴特吧。”
亨利笑着说。
“嘎嘎嘎嘎……”
小鸭子斯巴特也高兴地叫了起来。
page_text_en:
Duckling's Special Talents
1. Can float on water and also dive underwater. Can breathe with this. Bathing is fun, living by the water helps search for treasures at the bottom. Can catch fish, and also help retrieve things lost in the swimming pool.
2. Can fly: can host flying shows to earn pocket money. Good at remembering kites stuck in trees, frisbees flown into others' gardens, and other lost items. Can track others for foreign countries.
3. This unique duckling is also good at pleasing others — very clever.
4. Excellent at simple technical skills, can build castles, nests, and treehouses.
5. Now can make Indian headscarves, and can amuse little babies.
6. This duck can even talk — it's quite unusual, but not entirely impossible.
Additional
Won't shed feathers, won't bark randomly, doesn't need walks or professional training, won't chew furniture, shoes, or clothes, and won't urinate on carpets.
……handed to the duckling.
"Although you're not a dog,
still, you're not just an ordinary duck.
In fact, you're the most perfect pet I've ever met!"
"Let me think... how about we call you Spat?"
Henry said with a smile.
"Quack quack quack..."
The duckling Spat happily called out.
